System that integrates a language model (Phi-3 Mini) with Korean syllable-based text compression. It splits words into syllables, maps them to semantic blocks with color and meaning labels, then processes results through neural patterns extracted from Korean weights. The system compresses text by extracting structural meaning from syllable patterns, achieving about 3.19:1 compression ratio while preserving semantic content.
aions_core/agi_soft_retrieval.py: Differentiable retrieval system for training AI models end-to-end by allowing gradients to flow through retrieval decisions. Uses BM25 for initial filtering, computes soft attention over candidate documents with configurable temperature, and wraps the pipeline to measure citation coverage and entropy of attention weights. The entire retrieval process remains differentiable for backpropagation.
aions_core/aions_reactor.py: Complete learning system that executes complex goals across multiple rounds, evaluates performance in real-time, and distills insights into reusable skills. It orchestrates memory graphs, concept expansion, skill creation and performance tracking. Each round executes research, simulation, or distillation tasks, with advanced evaluation metrics tracking quality, latency, and knowledge graph integration.
aions_core/cbms_curve_machine.py: Breaks down a knowledge system into atomic kernels (small computational operations) and organizes them into execution graphs with data flow. Kernels include retrieval, compression, attention, selection and validation operations. The system generates execution schedules, manages weight manifests for various models (Phi-3, Mistral), and executes complex multi-step pipelines with gradient flow tracking.
aions_core/server/cbms_direct_server.py: Stopped at 1 line - file was already read before in batch.
aions_core/server/cbms_unified_server.py: Single HTTP server combining memory retrieval, fact checking, and optional neural commentary. Handles chat queries by routing them through CBMS memory lookups with fallback to web search when confidence is low, runs mathematical solver for numeric questions, and supports optional consciousness layer and conversation enhancement for more natural responses.
aions_core/server/facts_loader.py: Index loader for discrete facts stored as a collection with keyword-based retrieval. Tracks which facts are covered by a given query using cryptographic hashing and prefix matching of keywords. Provides coverage metrics showing how many facts overlap with a query's key concepts, useful for measuring knowledge base completeness.
aions_core/server/refgraph.py: Soft graph for tracking references between knowledge chunks that handles real-world messy data. Instead of requiring exact matches, it progressively resolves references with confidence scores: exact match (1.0), normalized form (0.75), semantic token overlap (0.3-0.55), or unresolved (0.0). Detects orphaned chunks and hubs, and identifies chunks at risk because they reference archived material.
aions_core/tools/analyze_csv.py: Scans a CSV file listing filesystem contents, tallying where JSON chunks are stored and locating critical files like skill definitions and knowledge manifests. Groups chunks by parent directory and searches for specific key files, useful for understanding repository structure and asset distribution across multiple locations.
aions_core/tools/harvest_memory.py: Consolidates knowledge chunks from multiple backup and development directories into a single canonical library. Recursively scans source directories, copies new chunks and updates existing ones with larger versions containing more information, tracking metrics for new additions and improvements to build a comprehensive unified knowledge base.
aions_core/tools/web_crawler_import.py: Web crawler that extracts factual statements from websites and imports them into a local fact store with semantic indexing. Filters HTML to extract text, splits into sentences of 40-280 characters, computes cryptographic hashes to prevent duplicates, and builds a keyword index using Korean syllable patterns for fast retrieval.
control_plane/agents/agent_runner.py: Executes tasks as a role-bound agent with filtered skill access and risk ceilings. Restricts which skills an agent can see via fnmatch patterns, plans using only allowed skills, evaluates risk class before execution, and never executes steps above the agent's risk threshold. Provides double protection: role-level filtering plus global risk gates.
control_plane/blends/write_conclusion.py: Loads analyzed blends (error/learning records), writes conclusions, and optionally exports them as CBMS chunks. Takes a seed blend, analyzes mistakes, generates conclusion text, saves to JSON, and can write directly to the chunk library with ingest tracking to ensure offline verification before production deployment.
control_plane/models.py: Data classes defining the schema for planning and execution: plans contain intent and steps with tool references, execution steps track status and output, and execution state logs overall progress. Step identifiers and plan identifiers are generated as UUIDs with custom prefixes for tracking and auditability.
control_plane/operator/mouth.py: Comments on system incidents using a locally-hosted language model without making decisions. Receives already-decided incident summaries from the deterministic operator loop and generates human-readable 1-2 sentence explanations of probable causes and suggested next steps, with graceful fallback if the model is unavailable.
control_plane/skills/context.py: Whitelist of helper functions that skills can safely call: file search via Everything CLI, note saving, app launching and closing, and persistent state get/set. Never exposes direct file or network access; skills must go through these vetted helpers, creating an isolation layer between skill code and system resources.
control_plane/skills/mcp_bridge.py: Thin adapter exposing skill engine functionality as MCP tools: list, search, and run skills; run task chains; list recipes. Re-discovers the skill registry on each call so freshly added skills appear without restarting, maintaining true plug-and-play behavior for a dynamic skill library.
control_plane/skills/semantic_search.py: Hybrid search blending lexical token overlap with embedding-based semantic similarity to rank skills by relevance. Uses Chroma as vector store with multiple collection versions (default embedder with English-optimized content, optional multilingual model). Applies thresholds to prevent false positives where unrelated skills score high due to embedding artifacts.
mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/desktop: Windows automation via MCP: takes screenshots, clicks, types (with Unicode clipboard fallback), presses key combos, scrolls, runs PowerShell commands, controls windows by title or handle, and builds simplified UI trees from accessibility APIs. All operations run on a dedicated thread to prevent blocking MCP's async loop.
Ultimate MCP server with automatic logging of every tool call to a buffer that periodically dumps to disk and ChromaDB. Integrates file search (Everything on Windows), docker/WSL/git commands, project scanning with dependency analysis, memory storage with Korean-key indexing, CBMS chunk retrieval, and operator profile loading for context about the system operator.
scripts/aions_tray.py: System tray icon manager for Claude Desktop showing green (running) or red (stopped) status. Provides menu to restart/stop/start Claude, open logs and configuration files, monitored via a background thread that checks process list every 5 seconds and updates icon appearance.
scripts/demo_papiery.py: Demonstration of paper (document/task) management as skills: adds sample papers with titles and deadlines, lists all papers, filters by urgency (due within N days), searches papers by keyword, and sends desktop notifications with urgent items. Shows skill discovery (model thinking about which skill fits each intent).
scripts/demo_windows_session.py: End-to-end monitored session opening Notepad, writing a file, displaying it, closing the app, and gathering system info. After each task, shows skill matching results and execution success. Demonstrates recipe learning: after manually chaining skills to solve a task, the system saves the sequence as a reusable recipe for future similar requests.
scripts/operator_profile_load.py: Loads the operator profile JSON from the canonical CBMS memory directory, containing metadata about who operates the system. Searches multiple possible paths (AIONS_PATH env var, common development locations), returns profile data or error details if the file is not found.
scripts/smoke_http_mcp.py: Smoke test for MCP server HTTP endpoint: sends an initialize handshake to establish a session, confirms the server name in the response, then lists available tools to verify the server is fully functional and responding to protocol requests.
scripts/test_node_registry.py: Smoke test for Faza 6 node registry (in-process and optional HTTP API): registers a test node, confirms heartbeat, creates a plan, executes a step, and verifies the full in-process flow. Also attempts HTTP calls to a remote registry API if available, gracefully skipping if the API is not running.
scripts/vault/open_secret.py: Opens encrypted entries from a DPAPI vault (Windows-only, requires user login). Lists vault entries with metadata or decrypts a specific entry and writes plaintext to a file with restrictive permissions (0600). For agent safety, stdout output is not echoed to chat; this must run locally with output written to filesystem only.
server/context_schema.py: Data schema for storing context metadata: agent identity, role, source (where data came from), turn number, tags, time-to-live in days, creation timestamp, and expiration time. Normalizes mixed metadata formats, converts non-scalar values to JSON strings, and computes TTL expiration for automatic cleanup of old context entries.
